effectiveDate.note: Entry-into-force date is stated by Presidential Library institutional chronology; ratification/exchange documentation must be attached before geometry verification.

geometry.derivationNote: Reconstruct the Kuril boundary from the treaty clause placing the border between Iturup and Urup. Use island coastlines appropriate to the period; the maritime line should not be expanded into a modern EEZ-style boundary.
Render Sakhalin as undivided/shared legal status under the treaty rather than assigning the whole island to either state. This state is superseded by the 1875 Petersburg settlement.
